page.layout: One printed page, numbered 357 at the top right. Main text in one column on the left, with a narrow column of text to the right of it, separated by a rule. Two marginal notes sit in the right margin: "* in" beside the Arabic line, and "& AlModhafferi." lower down. Below the text, the word AUTHORUM is centred.

main_text.p: (Fratrem tuum, fratrem tuum (tibi adjunge) &c. cui non est frater,* in Perinde est ac qui invitat ad certamen sine armis.

p.i: Affinis autem viri, scias, est ipsi ala,
Et nunquid ad volandum surget accipiter sine ala?

main_text.p: AlBaʒi est accipitris species. numeratur inter الجوارح ea animalia quae venari docentur, apud * AlDamirium, ubi obiter corrige in Locmanni Fabula de duobus gallis, بعض الجوارح ... & lege بعيط الجوارح i.e. avium praedatricium aliqua. Alludere videtur ad hoc proverbium AlHaririus his verbis كيف طيران دلا حناح Quomodo erit volatus, seu volabit quis sine ala? Plane geminum est illud Plautinum, Sine pennis volare haud facile est, mea ala pennas non habent.

Prov. 97. لجس من العدل سرعة العدل Non est ex justitia celeritas justitiae. ultimo loco lege العدل & verte, Non est justitiae celeritas reprehensionis. Occurrit apud AlHaririum. c. 25 Senusus autem est (explicante AlMaidanio) لا ينبغي ان يعجل بالعدل قبل ان يعرف العذر Non decet temere aliquem reprehendere antequam apologiam ejus cognitam habeas. Confer ergo ejusdem centuriae prov. 8. Forte qui audit rumorem de me, non audivit apologiam meam. & 9. Fortassis accusatur, nec deliquit.

page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew-type script lines are transcribed as best possible; Arabic words were not reliably readable and several are marked only in approximation. Column text on the right and the marginal "& AlModhafferi." note are printed in the right margin. The top-left and bottom edge show running material not transcribed. Several Arabic phrases and the Greek-like characters are uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
